name: @ap-federation/door-verifier
description: The door's OpenAC verifier (spec 443 W5 / Ring 0 zkID Z4): a Node service beside the Worker, because the 1k Prepare verifying key is 274 MB and no Worker holds it. It verifies a presentation against the proof request THE DOOR built, resolves the issuer facet THE DOOR trusts through the chain (spec 304), and reads the issuer's live-credential row on neutral ground. It holds no register, no key of anyone's, and decides nothing: it answers a verdict, and the door admits.
